mainEntity.name: What kind of paint do you use for interior projects, and are they low-VOC options?

acceptedAnswer.text: We primarily use high-quality paints from reputable brands known for their durability and excellent finish. We offer a range of options, including low-VOC (Volatile Organic Compound) paints. Low-VOC paints are a popular choice as they emit fewer harmful chemicals into the air, contributing to better indoor air quality and a safer environment for occupants, which is particularly beneficial for families and individuals with sensitivities. We can discuss specific low-VOC options during our consultation to align with your health and environmental preferences.
